english.tte_advice_help:
Advice only · click to refresh, hover for reasons
Choose any card. Auto-research requires the native gear.
english.tte_advice_wait:
No current suggestion
Click to recheck
english.tte_advice_empty_tip: No current valid suggestion, or goal priority is paused. Choose freely. Click to recheck; this does not start research.

simp_chinese.tte_advice_help:
仅供参考 · 点击建议刷新，悬停查看理由
手动选卡不受限制；齿轮开启后才会自动科研。
simp_chinese.tte_advice_wait:
暂无当前建议
点击重新检查
simp_chinese.tte_advice_empty_tip: 没有当前有效的建议，或目标优先已暂停。可自由手选；点击重新检查，不会开始科研。
